# has measured condition

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasMeasuredCondition`](gmeow-hasMeasuredCondition.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasMeasuredCondition>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory-environment`](../../slices/sensory-environment.md)

An objective measurement of the ambient conditions, expressed as a [`CoordinateMatrix`](../classes/gmeow-CoordinateMatrix.md) in a measurement reference frame. Non-functional: multiple instruments may produce competing measurements, and those claims coexist rather than collapse ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
